title: V7 builds source-linked institutional memory for long-running agents
friendlyTitle: V7 gives work agents a shared memory with links to the evidence
summary: V7 Go turns files from systems such as SharePoint and Google Drive into a context graph linking entities, facts, relationships and original evidence. V7 says agents can query that graph through MCP, fall back to document retrieval when needed and preserve an auditable trail across long financial and insurance workflows.
friendlySummary: V7 connects facts from company files into a graph that AI agents can search. The system keeps links back to the original documents and records the steps an agent takes.
whyItMatters: Reliable agents need governed business context, not just a larger prompt window. The pattern—structured memory, citations, retrieval fallback and traceable decisions—is useful even for teams using other vendors, though V7’s performance figures remain company-reported.
friendlyWhyItMatters: AI is more useful when it can find the right company information and show where each fact came from. Clear sources also make mistakes easier for people to check.
